# Koursea Blog

> High-intent, fact-checked Korea travel and K-beauty guidance for English-speaking visitors.

Koursea Blog publishes source-aware decision guides for payments, connectivity, medical-tourism planning, shopping and independent neighborhood itineraries. Time-sensitive claims should be verified against the official sources linked in each article.

## Core Guides

- [Korea Cosmetic Procedure Tax Refund Has Ended (2026)](https://blog.koursea.com/posts/korea-cosmetic-procedure-tax-refund-ended-2026-budget-guide/): Explains the end of the tourist refund for cosmetic procedures and provides transparent, tax-inclusive clinic budgeting checks.
- [Korean eSIM Guide: Why Data-Only Fails](https://blog.koursea.com/posts/korea-esim-with-phone-number-2026-guide/): Compares data-only and voice/SMS travel plans for restaurant queues, delivery apps, taxis and Korea phone verification.
- [Olive Young Tax Refund & Must-Buy Guide (2026)](https://blog.koursea.com/posts/guide-olive-young-tax-refund-must-buy-2026/): Covers participating-store limits, passport checks, airport refunds, flagship services and evidence-labeled shopping trends.
- [Korea Payment Guide: WOWPASS vs T-Money](https://blog.koursea.com/posts/korea-payment-wowpass-vs-tmoney-applepay-2026/): A decision guide to transit cards, Apple Pay limitations, cash-only transit reloads and foreign-card backup planning.
